fields.description: Program Description Introduction Chinese Language Studies Program is open to international students who love Chinese Language and Chinese culture. Students learn Chinese at the PKU School of Chinese as a Second Language as full-time general visiting students. Instruction is divided into elementary, intermediate, and advanced levels. Students are arranged into suitable classes according to the results of the Chinese placement test at the beginning of the semester. Class size is approximately fifteen students per class. Normally class hours are from Monday to Friday, four academic hours per day, twenty hours per week. Besides Chinese language studies in the classroom, Peking University also offers program students a series of activities to experience Chinese culture and get a deeper understanding of China. Upon completion of the program students will receive a program certificate and an official transcript. The program is normally one semester long, but students could applyfor extending their study period to at most four semesters in accumulation. When to Apply Fall Semester Admission: Online application starts on March 1st every year. Spring Semester Admission: Online application starts on November 1st every year. Note:Applications are on a “rolling” (first come, first served) basis – until full capacity. Only when the office receives the hardcopies of all the required documents will the application be processed. Admission Admission will be determined according to your educational background and the academic achievement. Upon acceptance, the University will send you the ‘Admission Notification’ as well as the ‘Visa Application for Study in China (Form JW202)’ at the end of the semester. Registration Period Fall Semester: In early September (specified in the Admission Notification); Spring Semester: In February (specified in the Admission Notification). PKU Academic Year Fall Semester: normally from September to January; Spring Semester: normally from February to June. Tuition Fee (per person) 18,000RMB/semester (one cost-free weekend tour included during the study period). Teaching Materials Fee 150-300RMB/semester Medical Insurance The Ministry of Education of China requires that all international students be medically insured throughout their entire planned period of study. Peking University international studentsare required to purchase the Comprehensive Insurance Plan of Foreign Students on the day of registration. Students who do not have valid medical insurance will not be allowed to register. For more information about the insurance, please visit the insurance company’s website (www.lxbx.net). Extracurricular Activities Peking University offers program students a series of extracurricular activities in both autumn and spring semesters to experience Chinese culture and get a deeper understanding of China. The following activities, which are subject to the exact notice of the semester, are for your reference. Semester Type Activity Time Autumn Semester In-City Tours Mutianyu Great Wall Visit September Beautiful Beijing Village Visit September PKU International Culture Festival October Temple of Heaven Visit and Acrobatics Performance November PKU International Students’ New Year Party (Buffet) December Weekend Tour Visit Mountain Tai and Confucius’s Hometown October Field Trip Visit Other Provinces and Cities Late June

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents in time. * 1. Two recommendation letters from your school/company (original documents, either in Chinese or English). * 2. Letter of Motivation/Study Plan 500-1000 words, in Chinese/English. Note: The students need to post original or certified copies to CUCAS. * 3. Photocopy of valid passport A photocopy of Passport Information page (With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included) * 4. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant * 5. Highest education certificate or studying certificate Either in Chinese or English Note: The students need to post original or certified copies to CUCAS. * 6. Academic transcript of highest education Either in Chinese or English Note: The students need to post original or certified copies to CUCAS. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport, and have a formal education background at high school level or above, in good health, above the age of 18 and under the age of 45. Applicants must have completed at least one year of university education. No prior knowledge of the Chinese language is required. Note: As it may close before deadline, so if you want to apply this program, please apply as soon as possible.
